decks.notes: The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of countermagic, hand disruption, and removal spells. The deck aims to control the board state and slow down the opponent's game plan, while also generating card advantage through abilities like Thoughtseize and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, as well as utility cards like Cling to Dust and Subtlety, provide additional ways to control the game and outvalue the opponent.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and counterspells. By utilizing a mix of efficient removal like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, players aim to outvalue their opponent and control the game tempo. The inclusion of cards like Flow State and Psychic Frog also provide additional card advantage and disruption tools, while supporting the strategy of maintaining control over the battlefield.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding cards help support the aggro strategy by boosting creature abilities and providing control against opposing threats. The deck also includes some powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial for removal and protection. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and spell support to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Superior Spider-Man, then using instant-speed reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a surprise attack. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to protect the combo, as well as card draw and filtering to ensure consistent combo pieces. The goal is to swiftly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats that are difficult to deal with.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays while utilizing a diverse range of colors to maximize its effectiveness. It includes powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Consign to Memory. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help control the board while Stubborn Denial offers protection. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional versatility. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and triomes to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, this deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures such as Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize. The archetype utilizes a mixture of instant spells and combo pieces to efficiently bring back threats from the graveyard and control the game tempo. By carefully managing resources and sequencing plays, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden burst of power and card advantage.

The key concept of this Modern control deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful threats such as Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek. The deck also includes versatile colorless spells like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the board and disrupt opponents' strategies. Using a combination of mana acceleration, disruption, and powerful finishers, this deck aims to outvalue and overwhelm opponents in the late game.

The deck focuses on utilizing a toolbox of creatures to assemble powerful combos and disrupt opponents. It includes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Young Wolf to control the board, while also using cards like Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for specific creatures. Malevolent Rumble and Agatha's Soul Cauldron provide removal and Graveyard recursion, while cards like Walking Ballista and Delighted Halfling offer additional win conditions. The main goal is to outvalue opponents by efficiently using the creatures in the deck to create advantageous board states and combo off for the win.

The deck focuses on fast aggressive plays using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ranger-Captain of Eos for card advantage and flexibility. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands for color fixing and consistency. The deck also incorporates cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional value and finishers like Voice of Victory to close out the game quickly.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage provided by Narset, Parter of Veils. The main goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up win conditions like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Solitude. The inclusion of a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, adds an extra layer of synergy and versatility to the deck. With a mix of control elements, card advantage, and powerful finishers, this deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent in a game of attrition.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to quickly ramp into powerful colorless spells and creatures, while maintaining control over the game through cards like Karn, the Great Creator, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and All Is Dust. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void, while ultimately overwhelming them with massive threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Devourer of Destiny. This deck focuses on combining control elements with high-powered mana acceleration to dominate the game.

This UW Control deck aims to control the game through counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing card draw and card selection to stay ahead in resources. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler to provide additional control and card advantage. Isochron Scepter can be used to repeatedly cast important spells like Counterspell or Tune the Narrative. The deck also includes ways to deal with creatures (Supreme Verdict, Solitude) and non-creature threats (Prismatic Ending). Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a long game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays with efficient removal and burn spells to control the board and push for quick victories. The deck utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to generate pressure early on, while also including powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional reach and utility. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for smooth curve-outs and explosive plays to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using Allosaurus Rider along with Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to quickly search for powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. By sacrificing smaller creatures to generate mana, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer helps protect the combo from disruption, while Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional utility and synergy with the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to win through explosive plays and efficient combos.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, backed up by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt opponents' strategies. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and can help close out games. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the board to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Writhing Chrysalis to generate a strong board presence. The deck utilizes Eldrazi creatures and support cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and removal spells, ultimately leading to victory through a combination of combo pieces and efficient play.
